groupings.title: Secrets
groupings.description: Agent-safe secret management with hal-vault: SSH-key encrypted storage, tag search, and masked-by-default output.

groupings.title: Media
groupings.description: Agent-safe image handling with ImageMagick: read metadata, resize/crop/composite/montage/watermark/convert, and lossless compression before sending so images stay small and never leak local paths.

groupings.title: Deploy
groupings.description: Publish static sites to shareable URLs. cloudflare-drop runs one packaged command built on the Wrangler CLI: permanent deploy to your Cloudflare account when CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN is set, or a 60-minute claimable *.workers.dev preview when not — always stating which you got, baking an honest expiry countdown into previews, self-verifying the served content (not just a 200), and refusing to invent a link. Optional -otp adds server-side six-digit access-code protection for permanent links only and fails closed.

groupings.title: Video
groupings.description: Generate video with the Ofox video API (Seedance 2.5). ofox-video-core is the shared execution layer (submit, poll, download, report cost) that seedance-short-drama (dialogue-driven short-drama shots), seedance-ad-creative (cinematic brand/product ad clips), seedance-product-video (clean white-background e-commerce product showcases), seedance-anime-drama (anime/manga storyboard shots with real image-based character consistency, orchestrating ofox-video-core with ofox-image-core), keyframe-animation (two stills you already have — start frame and end frame in one job, the model fills the middle), product-demo (two screenshots of one interface in two states, animated as a software demo), video-extend-edit (footage you already have, made longer or given a different ending: a frame is pulled out of the clip locally for free and becomes the first frame of a newly generated segment, which is joined back on), previs-rerender (a rough white-model, wireframe, blockout or animatic clip used as the locked shot-and-motion blueprint for a finished treatment), ugc-ads (handheld phone-shot creator clips that deliberately invert the polish the other scenarios default to), shorts-reels (several cheap vertical 9:16 drafts in one priced batch, then one proper re-render of the winner), talking-head (a portrait plus a short script, as one person saying those words to camera — the one scenario that runs on wan-3.0-prime rather than Seedance 2.5, because Seedance refuses a real person's photo), explainer (an article or release note as one spoken idea, since a 30-second clip holds about eighty words in eight sentences — measured, and well under a tenth of a 1,200-word post), and music-video (picture for a track you already have: the model never hears the audio, so the visuals are written to the song's sections and energy and your own file is muxed on locally at the end) build on for scenario-specific prompt craft and defaults.

groupings.title: Image
groupings.description: Generate and edit images with the Ofox image API (every image model Ofox serves; the model defaults to a cheapest-first priority chain that falls back and says so). ofox-image-core is the shared execution layer for this synchronous, no-job-id API: validates parameters, prices a job with --dry-run before spending, sends one request, decodes and saves the result, and reports real token usage. 'generate' draws from text; 'edit' takes a local image file and changes it (background swap, recolour, product-photo retouch) while leaving the rest intact. image-edit (one change to one picture, written so you can check what survived) and product-image (a set of product images to choose between, priced as a set total) are the scenario skills built on it.
